content:
From today, WhatsApp web users can view, preview, and annotate PDF files without leaving the conversation. Details as follows.

Adobe Acrobat has arrived on WhatsApp Web

Previously, when receiving a PDF file on WhatsApp, users had to download it before opening it, and there were no built-in tools available for viewing or annotating the document.

Adobe announced today that its Acrobat PDF tools have been directly integrated into WhatsApp Web and the WhatsApp Windows application, allowing users to open, view, and annotate documents without downloading files or leaving the conversation.

Adobe stated that, in addition to regular PDF files, this integration also supports password-protected documents, and files shared in conversations continue to be protected by WhatsApp's end-to-end encryption, "meaning only members of the conversation can read them," Adobe noted.

Adobe stated that this integration reflects two trends: users are increasingly using WhatsApp on larger screens to handle tasks such as viewing contracts, invoices, forms, and assignments; and its broader strategy of bringing Acrobat's PDF tools to the platforms where users are already working, "such as Chrome, Microsoft 365 and Copilot, ChatGPT, Workday, and more."
